title: Play card helpers
instructions:
Implement pure play-card helpers in game-core/src/engine/cards.ts (NO RNG, NO state mutation, NO classes). These compute what happens when a card is played from hand: which bonus icons it grants, which of its effects need a player decision (Prompt), and where the played card ends up (trash / discard / play area). The game reducer (a later task) wires these to PlayerState and creates actual Prompts. Rulebook authority: docs/rules/RULES-DIGEST.md 'Turn structure' + docs/rules/CARD-DATA-*.md.

STYLE RULES: strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No `any`. No classes. No default exports. Never mutate inputs — always return NEW objects with NEW copied arrays. Export ONLY what is listed. Import types ONLY from '../types': `import type { CardDef, CardBonuses } from '../types';`

File 1: game-core/src/engine/cards.ts
Exports:

1. `export interface BonusSnapshot { readonly cards: number; readonly gold: number; readonly ammo: number; readonly buys: number; readonly actions: number; readonly explores: number; }` — zero-defaulted totals of every bonus icon across a set of played cards.

2. `export function sumBonuses(cards: readonly CardDef[]): BonusSnapshot` — for each card, read its optional `bonuses` (CardBonuses); sum each of the six fields across all cards. Fields absent on a card count as 0. Empty input or cards without bonuses → all zeros. Returns a NEW flat object.

3. `export interface BonusPools { readonly turnAmmo: number; readonly turnGold: number; readonly actionsLeft: number; readonly buysLeft: number; readonly exploresLeft: number; }` — the per-turn resource pools a +X bonus adds to (the +Cards bonus is NOT a pool — it is a draw, returned separately as `draws`).

4. `export function applyBonusPools(pools: BonusPools, bonuses: BonusSnapshot): { readonly pools: BonusPools; readonly draws: number }` — returns a NEW BonusPools with gold/ammo/actionsLeft/buysLeft/exploresLeft each increased by the matching bonus (cards bonus is NOT added to a pool), and draws = bonuses.cards. Inputs unchanged (fresh arrays/objects in the result).

5. `export type PromptKind =
     | 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'
     | 'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory'
     | 'trashHandCard'
     | 'lookAtMansionTop'
     | 'negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand'
     | 'healGreenHerb';` — machine-readable kinds of decisions a played card can require. The reducer turns these into actual Prompt objects with concrete options; this module only reports WHICH decisions are needed, in play order.

6. `export function promptsFor(card: CardDef): readonly PromptKind[]` — walk the card's effects IN ORDER (weaponEffects? then actionEffects? then itemEffects? then tokenEffects?) and emit one PromptKind per effect that needs a decision; effects that resolve immediately emit nothing. EXACT mapping:
   - actionEffects: 'allWeaponsPlusDamageThisTurn' → (immediate, no prompt); 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand' → 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'; 'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory' → 'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory'; 'trashHandCard' → 'trashHandCard'; 'negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand' → 'negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand'; 'lookAtMansionTop' → 'lookAtMansionTop'.
   - itemEffects: 'healToFull' → (immediate, no prompt); 'plusMaxHp20' → (immediate, no prompt); 'healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60' → 'healGreenHerb' (the player chooses heal-20 vs heal-60).
   - weaponEffects: ALL kinds (plusDamagePerExtraWeapon, plusDamageIfAmmoAbove, grantExplores) → (immediate, no prompt).
   - tokenEffects: 'gainWeaponAndTrashToken' → (immediate, no prompt).
   - No effects at all (undefined arrays) → []. If the same kind appears in more than one effect entry, emit it once (dedupe), keeping first position in order.

7. `export function trashDestination(card: CardDef, opts?: { readonly explosivesToDiscard?: boolean }): 'removed' | 'discard' | 'keep'` — where the played card ends up:
   - card.type === 'item' → 'removed' (Green Herb, First Aid Spray, Yellow Herb: trashed when used).
   - card.type === 'token' → 'removed' (Rocket Launcher Case / Gatling Gun Case: trashed after gaining the weapon).
   - card.type === 'weapon' AND weaponTags includes 'explosive' → 'removed' (Grenade, Rocket Launcher: trashed after use), UNLESS opts?.explosivesToDiscard is true → 'discard' (Jill L2 ability: explosives go to discard instead of trash).
   - everything else (actions, ammunition, non-explosive weapons) → 'keep' (goes to the play area, discarded at turn end by the normal flow).
   - opts undefined behaves like {}. Never throws.

File 2: game-core/src/engine/cards.test.ts
Vitest tests (globals are enabled; bare test()/expect() works). MUST import first: `import { sumBonuses, applyBonusPools, promptsFor, trashDestination } from './cards';` and `import type { BonusSnapshot, BonusPools, PromptKind } from './cards';` and `import type { CardDef } from '../types';`. Build CardDef literals inline — do NOT import any card database. Note: CardDef requires id, name, type, set ('premier'), text, copies — always include them; optional fields only when the test needs them. Test EXACTLY these cases:

1. sumBonuses empty: () → {cards:0, gold:0, ammo:0, buys:0, actions:0, explores:0}.
2. sumBonuses with three cards: ammo x10 {bonuses:{ammo:10,gold:10}}, weapon shotgun {bonuses:{explores:1}}, action Merchant {bonuses:{buys:1,cards:1,gold:20}} → {cards:1, gold:30, ammo:10, buys:1, actions:0, explores:1}.
3. sumBonuses card with no bonuses field: {id:'we-004',name:'Combat Knife',type:'weapon',set:'premier',text:'',copies:11,damage:5,ammoReq:0} → all zeros.
4. applyBonusPools: pools {turnAmmo:0, turnGold:0, actionsLeft:1, buysLeft:1, exploresLeft:1}, bonuses {cards:2, gold:20, ammo:10, buys:1, actions:1, explores:1} → pools {turnAmmo:10, turnGold:20, actionsLeft:2, buysLeft:2, exploresLeft:2}, draws 2; input pools object unchanged (deep compare + fresh object in result).
5. applyBonusPools zeros: every field could be added with zero — pools {turnAmmo:5, turnGold:5, actionsLeft:1, buysLeft:1, exploresLeft:1}, bonuses all-zero → identical pools values, draws 0.
6. promptsFor Deadly Aim (immediate): action card {actionEffects:[{kind:'allWeaponsPlusDamageThisTurn',amount:10}]} → [] .
7. promptsFor Reload: {actionEffects:[{kind:'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'}]} → ['recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'].
8. promptsFor Umbrella: {actionEffects:[{kind:'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory'}]} → ['moveHandCardToTopOfInventory'].
9. promptsFor Ominous Battle: {actionEffects:[{kind:'trashHandCard'}]} → ['trashHandCard'].
10. promptsFor Struggle: {actionEffects:[{kind:'negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand'}]} → ['negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand'].
11. promptsFor Mansion Foyer: {actionEffects:[{kind:'lookAtMansionTop',count:2}]} → ['lookAtMansionTop'].
12. promptsFor Green Herb: {itemEffects:[{kind:'healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60'}]} → ['healGreenHerb'].
13. promptsFor First Aid Spray: {itemEffects:[{kind:'healToFull'}]} → [].
14. promptsFor Yellow Herb: {itemEffects:[{kind:'plusMaxHp20'}]} → [].
15. promptsFor weapon effects (shotgun + burst-fire handgun): {weaponEffects:[{kind:'grantExplores',amount:1},{kind:'plusDamagePerExtraWeapon',amount:20}]} → [] (all immediate).
16. promptsFor Rocket Launcher Case token: {tokenEffects:[{kind:'gainWeaponAndTrashToken',weaponCardId:'we-008'}]} → [].
17. promptsFor dedupe + order: {itemEffects:[{kind:'healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60'},{kind:'healToFull'}], actionEffects:[{kind:'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'}]} → order: actionEffects walk FIRST, then itemEffects (per spec order: weaponEffects, actionEffects, itemEffects, tokenEffects) → expected ['recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand', 'healGreenHerb']. (healToFull emits nothing.)
18. promptsFor no effects: {id:'we-004',name:'Combat Knife',type:'weapon',set:'premier',text:'',copies:11,damage:5,ammoReq:0} → [].
19. trashDestination item: Green Herb-like {type:'item'} → 'removed'.
20. trashDestination token: {type:'token',tokenEffects:[{kind:'gainWeaponAndTrashToken',weaponCardId:'we-007'}]} → 'removed'.
21. trashDestination explosive weapon: {type:'weapon',weaponTags:['explosive','gun'],damage:15,ammoReq:0} → 'removed'; same card with opts {explosivesToDiscard:true} → 'discard'.
22. trashDestination explosive weapon opts undefined: same card, call trashDestination(card) (no second arg) → 'removed'.
23. trashDestination action: {type:'action',actionEffects:[{kind:'allWeaponsPlusDamageThisTurn',amount:10}]} → 'keep'.
24. trashDestination ammunition: {type:'ammunition',bonuses:{ammo:10,gold:10}} → 'keep'.
25. trashDestination non-explosive weapon: {type:'weapon',weaponTags:['gun'],damage:10,ammoReq:20} → 'keep'.

Do NOT weaken, reorder, or add assertions beyond this list. Export types and functions with the EXACT names above. Every expected value follows the rulebook + types.ts unions — trust them.
